fees.note: From the city's camping pages (read 2026-10-14): a full-hookup site is $40 a night all year; a regular site (electric and community water) is $35 March to October, posted as the weekday rate, and $30 November to February, or $30 all year for a non-preferred site. Primitive sites ($20-25) take only a pop-up or camp van and are left out. Online bookings carry a 3.5% booking fee and card payments 1.5%. The city's CampLife calendar shows availability only after a login.

fees.note: From the park's rates page (read 2026-10-14): C$89 plus HST a night for an RV pull-through site for 2 people, with 30-amp power and non-potable water.
